verseText: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth; break forth — let your cry ring out, and sing praises!
meaning: God made us to worship him and enjoy his goodness. We can give him praise by joyfully singing about his greatness.

recall.question: What does this verse tell all the earth to do?
choices: Make a joyful noise to the LORD
Dance a joyful dance to the LORD
Jump a joyful jump to the LORD

meaning.question: To praise God means to honor Him for who He is and what He does. Why do we sing praises to Him?
choices: To celebrate His greatness and goodness
To make Him love us more
To show everyone how good we are at singing

application.prompt: Think of something wonderful about God or something He has done that makes you thankful. What song could help you celebrate that? You can sing it to Him or use your own joyful words to tell Him why you are thankful.
